title: Types in React
description: Learn how to add types to React components, props, and state.
longDescription: Types in React shows how to bring TypeScript safety into your React components. Starting with how to type functional components themselves, you will progress to typing props with interfaces and unions, annotating component state with useState and useReducer, and handling React events with the correct generic event types. The final lesson covers React's special props—children, keys, and refs—so your components stay fully typed even when using advanced React patterns. This module assumes you have completed TypeScript Basics.
